title: Thalia Breaks the Helvault Under Liliana's Threat
summary: Liliana coerces the cathar Thalia into shattering the Helvault, releasing both Griselbrand and Avacyn.
narrative: During the darkening crisis in Thraben, Liliana Vess hunted Griselbrand, one of the demons she sought to kill to escape her binding bargains. The demon was confined within the Helvault, alongside Avacyn.

A later official account identifies Thalia, guardian of the cathedral's prison, as the one forced to break it. Liliana threatened the soldiers in Thalia's command until the cathar submitted to the demand.

The single rupture released both Avacyn and the demons held within the Helvault, including Griselbrand. Liliana was pursuing a personal debt, while the return of Avacyn restored the Church's protection as an unintended consequence of the prison breaking.

The original Dark Ascension Helvault printing is a depiction of the artifact and foreshadows its destruction mechanically. It is not a scene painting of Liliana threatening Thalia. Thalia does not yet have a dedicated character entry in this archive.
